title: Self-Deploy — Microsoft Entra: Identity Fundamentals
author_notes: Self-Deploy (foundational). Lab scripts; read-only. PowerShell (Microsoft.Graph / Az) + KQL. Change scripts -WhatIf/report-only-first + break-glass; licensing (P1/P2/Governance/GSA/Verified ID) + preview flagged verify.
